quote: The Antofagasta Region’s Environmental Evaluation Commission (Coeva) approved the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) for the Spence Operational Adequacy project, an initiative by BHP’s Spence mine involving US$1.7 billion in investment… “The ‘Spence Operational Adequacy’ project involves upgrading the mine’s current leaching operation to extend its useful life until 2039,” the company’s EIA explained.
